limitations: The result does not settle the general PDE-singleton determinacy question; it requires finite ray fibers, and the algebraic corollary assumes a zero set avoiding the origin. It is nonquantitative and does not cover algebraic supports with a radial-line component. Differently phrased, unpublished, or poorly indexed prior coverage may exist; independent audit has not been performed.
record_title: Finite ray fibers remove the injectivity hypothesis in algebraic complex-moment extensions
